title: Actuation Station
description: Explore the capabilities of different robot types as you deliver various drugs and cells to a wound site

title: Flappy Blob
description: Be the adaptive controller for flappy blob as it navigates through different pipes under different conditions!

title: Wound Healing Saga
description: Become the Cellular Commander and guide a patient's wound through healing. Manage cells, fight threats, and ensure minimal scarring.

title: Bloody Snake in a Sponge!
description: Keep your blood vessel (snake) alive by eating growth food, avoiding shrink food, and providing some stimulation from time to time, as it navigates through a porous sponge!

title: Biological Network Sense
description: Design and manage a network of biological sensors to accurately read environmental values at specific target concentration zones, while managing energy costs

title: Hydrogel Quest
description: Navigate the lab, collect ingredients, and synthesise a hydrogel in this fun educational game!
